records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Cola River
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: Nothing washes Taffy’s worries away like a Rabbit Cola. If she’s still crashing out, that just means she hasn’t had enough cola!
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A wallpaper used often by Taffy. Everything’s grand with a cola in hand!

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Delivery Monster
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: While Taffy is well-versed in handling deliveries, the most fearsome beast she must contend with…are damaged packages which gobble up big chunks of her paycheck!
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A component used often by Taffy: Damaged packages = Bye bye paycheck!

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Variegated Routine
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: For many Nova streets, Bansy is an artist injecting some much-needed color into the gray monotony.
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A wallpaper used often by Bansy. When tagging, black is easier.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Graffiti Paint
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: Unlike the paint Bansy usually carries. Trying out different colors on occasion can be nice.
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A component used often by Bansy. Resembles wet paint.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Meteor Trail
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: For Dila, seeing one star fall from another is just another day.
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A wallpaper used often by Dila, capturing a meteor streaking through the sky.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Waxing Moon
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: A perfectly ordinary moon, identical to ones Dila has seen before.
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A component used often by Dila. A rarely seen crescent moon.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Urban Shadows
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: Street-level views of Nova as seen through the patrol car window constitute the most familiar landscape in Richie’s life.
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A wallpaper used often by Richie, showing a common street scene in Nova City.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Delicious Fantasy
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: After working on cases for too long, the starving Richie imagines street sign morphing into a tantalizing pizza.
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A component used often by Richie: a scrumptious pizza.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Chilled Milk
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: The color-changing cow pattern resembles the icy-cold milk that Anonym so adores.
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A wallpaper used often by Anonym which is inspired by cow patterns.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Cow Adventure
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: Anonym once saw aliens abducting a cow, and did her best to stop them, only to… wake up?
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A component used often by Anonym: the adventurous cow

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Dining Etiquette
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: The light blue placemat paired with such elegant tableware creates a sense of ritual that makes Aileen feel at ease.
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A wallpaper used often by Aileen, featuring her go-to dining set.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Leisurely Sweetness
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: These special donuts, which can’t be found on the Dream Garden menu, are Aileen’s secret treats to reward herself.
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A component used often by Aileen: donuts drizzled with a sweet sauce.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Pixel Command
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: Mimiko scores a flawless victory with the classic combo Up, Up, Down, Down, Left, Right, Left, Right, B, A.
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A wallpaper used often by Mimiko showing the forward button being pressed.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Game Time
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: A true gamer like Mimiko always keeps a charging cable close to her controller.
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A component used often by Mimiko that’s always ready to charge up for an adventure.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Eternal Bug
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: For Seymour, bugs are eternal companions, immortal and awaiting rebirth in the code graveyard.
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A wallpaper used often by Seymour: remaining ever vigilant against bugs.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Monster Monitoring
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: To prevent his home from being destroyed, Seymour has to constantly monitor the furry beast that treads upon his keyboard.
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A component used often by Seymour for built-in cat monitoring.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: MM Component
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: Mecha picked the most aesthetically pleasing component from the pile on her workbench and turned it into a geometric pattern on the screen.
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A wallpaper used often by Mecha which is inspired by MM components.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Radionaut
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: The composition is a bit strange because Mecha shouted “cheese” before the Radionauts were ready.
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A component used often by Mecha: a photo with the Radionauts.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Breaking Boundaries
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: With the rebellious phrase “Rule Breaker,” Garm’s ambition for freedom is always ignited.
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A wallpaper used often by Garm: a record of freedom and rebellion.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: DK9 Graffiti
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: Whenever Garm picks up her phone, she can see the DK9 graffiti that represents freedom and passion.
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A component used often by Garm: the emblem of the DK9 Crew.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Emote Claw Machine
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: Ringo is like a claw machine packed with vivid emotions, with joy being the easiest prize to snag.
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A wallpaper used often by Ringo. She’s much like a claw machine herself.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Emote Claw
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: Ringo’s signature emote: a smile so bright it almost reaches the temples. Try use this one in today’s chat.
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A component used often by Ringo: bubbling over with happiness!

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Midnight Undertow
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: The evening is bathed in blue; evidence tags tell faint tales of the crime scene as Lykaia maneuvers through the dark undercurrent in pursuit of the truth.
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A wallpaper used often by Lykaia: just another day at the NCCA.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: High-Speed Dashboard
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: When the night is quiet, Lykaia finally casts off her professional responsibilities and speeds headlong into freedom.
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A component used often by Lykaia: perfect for after-work joyrides.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Heart-Pounding Moment
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: When sprinting on the court, Alan’s heart beats as passionately as it did when he first tasted freedom.
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A wallpaper used often by Alan: a symbol of uncomplicated bliss.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Hollow Ball
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: One of Alan’s signature moves: the ball nimbly sails over the rim and through the net like an unbound, free spirit.
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A component used often by Alan: a basketball charging toward freedom.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Dopamine Colors
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: It has a magical way of brightening your day the moment you see it.
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A spin-off wallpaper from Dopamine Drift.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Kitty Game Console
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: A pixel-art cat-servant simulator.
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A spin-off component from Dopamine Drift.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Collapsed City

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Monster Fantasy
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: Klameedo once dreamed of holding NeutraMan in the palm of its hand.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Beyond the Finish Line
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: Past the checkered flag, the story races on.
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A spin-off wallpaper from Blazing Meteor.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Windshear Shadow
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: The moment you cross the finish line, the world fades and only wind remains.
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A spin-off component from Blazing Meteor.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Dangerous Waters

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: A red crown symbolizing one’s vampiric lineage.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A spin-off wallpaper from the Ember Weave.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Chongxiao Knot
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: A flaming heart that beats perpetually, its passion never fading.
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A spin-off component from the Ember Weave.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Misty Teal Mark
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: Wander through a low-saturation world.
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A spin-off wallpaper from the Misty Teal Noir.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Immersive Melody
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: Lose yourself in a misty-blue melody.
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A spin-off component from the Misty Teal Noir.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Classroom Days
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: Setting aside the extraordinary background and an unmistakable air of mastery, Rin still sits in class like any ordinary student, listening attentively.
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A wallpaper used often by Rin: peaceful days on campus.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Blade Unsheathed
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: The weapon Rin has trained with since childhood. When the blade is unsheathed, all who draw near tremble with fear.
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A component used often by Rin: a symbol of the weapon Rin always keeps close.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Racing Vista
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: At full speed, light and shadow take a backseat and everything blurs into streaks, as if being hurled through space and time. It’s a sight Bai Jing has seen countless times on the track.
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A wallpaper used often by Bai Jing: memories of racing against the wind.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Bygone Glory
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: It commemorates Bai Jing’s old racing number and the glory days that, while they once shook the racing world, are now slowly fading from memory.
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A component used often by Bai Jing: a buried past.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Verdant Tea Leaves
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: No need to visit the tea mountains. Simply look down and greenery fills your view, transporting you from your desk back to the tea garden with a single glance.
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A wallpaper used often by You Zhi: serene and understated.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Fragrant Tea Brewing
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: Savoring tea beneath the camellia tree, steam rising and a faint fragrance drifting by. Of course, it’s only a figment of You Zhi’s imagination.
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A component used often by You Zhi: sitting quietly in the blossom shade, sipping pristine tea.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Nightfall Descends
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: As midnight nears, dormant snakes slither out from hiding. Shi Ye thinks it suits her personality perfectly.
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A wallpaper used often by Shi Ye, who favors a passionate, eerie red.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Coiled Serpent Bracelet
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: Starlight tinges the serpent’s scales with a faint glow. The silver snake looks back, poised to strike, yet with a gaze verging on tender.
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A component used often by Shi Ye: a silver serpent entwined with starlight.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Plump Crab Feast
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: Steam a couple of plump crabs, set out a few dishes of vinegar and pair it with a cup of good tea. For Cheng Niang, this is autumn’s greatest delight.
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A wallpaper used often by Cheng Niang: crisp autumn skies and crabs at their plumpest.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Crab-Filled Orange
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: Cheng Niang has long tried to recreate the crab-stuffed orange she was fond of as a child. An ancient Lingyun recipe instructs to take a large orange, cut off its top, and fill it with crab roe and meat.
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A component used often by Cheng Niang, inspired by a famous Lingyun dish.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Weilan Ripples
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: On Fufeng’s rare days off, there are no notifications and no mission briefings. Only the quietude of Weilan Lake and a passing breeze.
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A wallpaper used often by Fufeng: the view that fills his eyes in idle moments.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Field Partner
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: Fufeng’s criteria for picking a component: simple, easy on the eyes, and reminds him to bring a pen. This one checks all three.
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.ShortDesc: A component used often by Fufeng: a reassuring partner out in the field.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Pinchbot Mug
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: This ceramic mug features an adorable Pinchot-shaped design. Some people even use it as a tabletop trash can to get the enjoyable experience of feeding a Pinchbot.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Kitty Plushie Capsule Toy
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: This popular Chaos toy, which is a hit around the world, is a self-caring cat figurine, which lazy pet owners consider a blessing.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Cycling Bunny Keychain
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: A plush bunny keychain, one of the favorite handbag accessories for all Nova girls. Inspired by the bunny that is often seeing racing through the streets of Nova City.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Chaos Story Collection
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: A deluxe edition of the adventure magazine Urban Odyssey, featuring a compilation of page-turning Chaos stories.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Movie Crossover Car Model
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: A realistic sports car model created in collaboration with the movie Ace Racer and the MetaManga store. Captures every detail of the protagonist’s vehicle.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Steering Wheel Necklace
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: An accessory created as part of a collaboration between Spectrum and Merse—With this, you’re the one behind the wheel.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Drive-in Theater Ticket
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: A ticket for a one day drive-in theater-going experience The juxtaposition of an outdoor parking lot and the silver screen creates a viewing experience completely different from an indoor theater.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Old Movie Disk
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: Disk sold at video stores, primarily featuring classic old films. Sometimes you can find some real cinematic gems.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Movie Calendar
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: A calendar so beautifully crafted, you almost hate to tear pages off. Featuring classic film stills paired with descriptions, it give daily recommendations for cinematic masterpieces.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Car Refrigerator
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: A portable large-capacity car refrigerator capable of keeping things cool for extended periods. Perfect keeping your food fresh on the go.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Cold-blooded Kitchen Knife
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: A kitchen essential that makes peeling potatoes a breeze. No ingredient can survive more than three seconds under its razor-sharp blade—every chef’s dream knife.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Portable Cooking Set
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: An outdoor cooking set that includes a hanging pot and frying pan. Heat-resistant and easy to handle, you can showcase your culinary skills, even in the great outdoors!

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Extra-large Capacity Water Bottle
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: An extra-large water bottle suitable for both travel and office use, so there’s no need for those constant refills!

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Sturdy Frying Pan
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: A durable cast-iron frying pan that is both scratch-resistant and non-stick, allowing you to easily fry the perfect sunny-side-up eggs. It could also potentially double as a self-defense weapon.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Motor Tool Set
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: A motor tool set from Marine MechWorks that is affordable, reliable, and durable. Exudes a strong modern industrial vibe.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Hydrating Toner
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: The number one bestselling toner from Indigo! Fully meets all your skincare needs by boasting the triple effect of hydration, soothing, and stabilization.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Aromatherapy Crystals
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: Orange blossoms crumpled by the evening breeze create ripples, as a gentle midsummer night’s mist rises beside your pillow. Good night, and sweet dreams.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Cherry Moss Landscape Box
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: In a private oasis resides an eternal cherry blossom tree. The lifelike cherry blossom branches droop low, while the mossy grass holds cherished memories in a verdant embrace.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Weather Storm Bottle
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: A miniature weather station sealed inside a glass container, although the projected forecast may differ from reality.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Hypercore Single Visit Pass
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: Hypercore does away with the traditional annual membership model, unlocking fitness freedom on a per-use basis! No future commitments, no wasted workout motivation.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Fat Burners Supplements Kit
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: Includes dietary fiber powder, black coffee, protein bars, and other workout essentials to burn fat around the clock.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Multifunctional Massage Gun
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: An essential device for fitness enthusiasts to relieve post-workout muscle tension and soreness.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Gold Coin Keycap
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: A spin-off of the strategy game #iChaos Wars#z, designed to enhance the out-of-game experience with an enhanced sense of ritual and support in-game economic growth.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Greatsword Keychain
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: A collectible item from the action game #iFlames of Blasphemy#z which recreates the classic weapon design, allowing you to carry a touch of battle-based beautify wherever you go.

records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Name: Acrylic Flowing Sand Stand
records.LT.ConfigGen.ICommonItemConfig.Descripti: A collaboration between the games #iSour Groove#z and Lemon Sour, this stand features a striking flowing sand design whose movement awakens a waterfall of musical notes.
